acceptanceCriteria: A stub or cleanup registry imported from a sibling module is resolved, or the rule reports an explicit cross-file abstention reason.
A test whose fixture seeds the collection does not get VACUOUS-EMPTY-EQUALITY.
JSON contracts have a documented annotation form (for example a sibling key) with a positive and negative fixture.
body: Limits retained by the V1-1919/1930/1931/1932 lane (PR #1201, TSA-V0-160..176): (1) stub and fixture scope is per file, so stubs declared in another file and imported cleanup registries make UNSTUBBED-OUTBOUND-INPUT and CLEANUP-HANDLE-OUTLIVED abstain or miss; (2) VACUOUS-EMPTY-EQUALITY does not model fixture seeding, so a seeded test without an explicit precondition still gets the advisory; (3) JSON contracts cannot carry the EITHER-OR justification annotation because JSON has no comment lines. Run-time parts (ENV-UNSTUBBED-CALL, run-time vacuous reading, row-citation drift, single-value proposal) stay with V1-1931/V1-1932/V1-1930.
title: Test-validity rules: model cross-file stubs, imported cleanup registries, fixture seeding and JSON contract annotations
